proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Working with the correspondence between irreducible components through a point and minimal primes of the local ring, the base change of lemma-groupoid-on-field-explain-points makes the source and target maps isomorphisms, and faithful flat local maps transfer uniqueness of minimal primes back, while the move-point automorphism reduces part (1) to part (2). In the separably closed case, the product of two irreducible components through the identity is irreducible and its composition image is an irreducible set containing both components: for a T-valued point of either component the identity axiom c(x, e composed with s composed with x) = x together with e lying on the other component exhibits each component inside the image, forcing them equal. In general the separable algebraic closure has a unique component through the lifted identity, faithful flatness reflects this to uniqueness on R, and the Galois orbit lemma with the one-point fibre over the identity gives invariance of the component, i.e. geometric irreducibility via s and via t. (source lines 1454-1512)
